direction.premise: A personal scouting notebook for two friends who want to understand years of shared matches, with measured evidence rather than competitive ranking between them.
direction.composition: Cream reading surface and a dark chapter rail; on phones the rail becomes a horizontally scrolling chapter index above the account switch and evidence-led document.
direction.shapeLanguage: Square evidence tables, thin ruled dividers, open editorial whitespace and an acid-green cut-corner player dossier distinguish observations from narrative.
direction.surfaceAndMaterial: Flat printed-paper surfaces and ink-colored text; hero portraits are small secondary identifiers, not decorative background art.
direction.paletteLogic: Cream supports extended reading, dark green groups navigation, lime marks selected context, muted rust marks a small sample rather than a losing player.
direction.typography: Large tight headings introduce chapters, compact sans-serif tables use tabular numeric context, and small uppercase source labels separate claims from qualifications.
direction.signature: Changing the selected hero redraws an eight-season dot-and-line evidence strip; missing seasons remain visibly disconnected and small samples have hollow points.
direction.distinction: Perekos and Katana Echo center combat arenas; this product centers a readable evolving dossier, with chapter navigation and filterable evidence rather than thumb combat controls.

architecture.primaryVerb: Inspect a hero or shared pairing, then change season or mode to test whether the conclusion survives a narrower evidence slice.
architecture.physicalFeedback: The active tab changes immediately and the evidence table and plot redraw synchronously; repeat input replaces the current selection without delayed motion.
architecture.spatialRationale: A long-form analytical document genuinely needs vertical reading; compact horizontal chapter tabs preserve phone width while controls remain next to the evidence they alter.

comparisons.spatialDifference: Perekos fills the phone with a top-down duel and perimeter health; this notebook gives most pixels to readable evidence columns and ruled chapter content.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Hero selection and table filtering replace two-thumb movement, spell aiming and real-time projectile avoidance.

comparisons.spatialDifference: Crumple Yard centers a third-person deforming vehicle and crash course; this notebook has an editorial document and scrollable numeric evidence.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Selecting an account and inspecting historical seasons has no continuous steering or garage-to-world camera transitions.

production.renderer: DOM and CSS retain selectable long-form analysis, accessible tables and responsive controls; inline SVG renders numeric seasonal plots without a raster chart dependency.
production.focalAsset: The focal asset is the actual evidence document. An original SVG R-and-slash notebook mark is authored locally for installation; external portraits are optional source-linked identifiers.

motion.character: Precise and immediate context changes keep repeated analytical filtering comfortable and avoid presenting animation as statistical significance.
motion.action: Choose the second account in the persistent account switch and observe the entire document adopt that player context.
motion.anticipation: Button press darkens in the first frame; there is no artificial delay before changing a data context.
motion.response: The pressed account becomes dark and the headline, dossier name and hero pool change together.
motion.followThrough: The selected account stays visibly marked while the reader moves through chapters; graphs keep their axis and sample annotations.
motion.interruption: Rapid chapter or account changes overwrite the current render immediately rather than queuing transitions.
motion.reducedMotion: Reduced-motion disables smooth scrolling and transitions; the same selection, account state and evidence remain visible.

evidence.expectedChange: The active player switches from JustSadSock to Hioydfts and the dossier headline, hero portraits and statistics reflect the second public account.
